gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-hedvig-letters-sa: Hedvig Letters Sans has a friendly, contemporary face, with a wide gap where the c ends and small letters nearly as tall as capitals. Conthrax, the display heading above it, keeps one stroke width in every glyph, so a long read feels like following a single thread.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-heebo: Clean, geometric Conthrax holds a constant stroke width up top, while Heebo's plain sans body has a tall central band and curves that stop short. That steady line against open curves is the pair's real charm.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-hind-guntur: Hind Guntur draws wide gaps between curve ends and stems, with tall lowercase that looks stamped from metal and no thick-thin shift. Conthrax lends the display heading a geometric, clean punch, and the body follows it without a fuss.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-hind-madurai: Hind Madurai opens its s curves wide at both ends, and its lowercase fills the line almost like capitals. Hind Madurai's stroke ends look cut from one ribbon, which gives Conthrax's geometric display heading a softer sans-serif partner.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-hind-mysuru: Conthrax leads with a wide-mouthed lowercase a and bodies so tall the capitals barely rise above them, geometric and clean. Hind Mysuru's sans-serif lowercase presses close to ascender height, so the shared tall stance is what holds them together.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-hind-siliguri: Hind Siliguri has rounds that gap like a cracked bangle and a gentle bump from small letters to capitals. Hind Siliguri hums at a constant line weight below Conthrax, whose geometric display shapes carry all the swagger.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-hind-vadodara: Spacious and open, Hind Vadodara shows big e and a shapes with tall bowls and gaps at the ends of its rounds. Hind Vadodara's thickness never shifts with direction, which echoes the constant stroke of Conthrax above it.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-huninn: Huninn keeps its s terminals clear of the body, and its lowercase rises close to cap height with crossbars as fat as the stems. Huninn is best given a size a notch larger than usual, so those sturdy forms have room beside Conthrax.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-inter-tight: Inter Tight draws its lines like bent tubing, with short ascenders and curve tails held back. Beneath it, Conthrax's geometric display letters give the page a bold, clean top, while the plain sans text stays compact and quiet.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-karla: Stems and crossbars share one thickness in Conthrax, which makes its display shapes look machined and clean. Karla follows with a gaping c opening and a middle band so tall the line looks stocky, a friendly counterweight.
